description: This file provides regional localization strings for the Select2 library (version 4.0.6-rc.1), specifically for the Malay (ms) language. It defines messages for various UI states such as loading, errors, input validation, and selection limits.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when loading results fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to remove excess characters when input exceeds maximum allowed.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to input more characters when input is too short.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message shown while loading additional results.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of selectable options has been reached.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when no matching results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message shown when searching for results.
